description.value: A two-storey pet-friendly hotel situated in the heart of Sidney-by-the-Sea, a short walk from the waterfront, local bookshops, and restaurants of this charming Vancouver Island town. The property offers complimentary cruiser bicycle rentals so guests can explore the Saanich Peninsula without their own wheels, alongside a fitness centre stocked with Peloton equipment. It serves as a natural staging point for cyclists arriving or departing via the nearby BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal.

address.value: 2306 Beacon Avenue, Sidney, British Columbia V8L 1X2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The hotel's own website (bwemeraldisle.com) was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. It confirms the address, phone number, and a clear amenities page listing laundry, Wi-Fi, complimentary continental breakfast, and complimentary cruiser bicycle rentals. No mention of secure storage for guests' own bikes or staff bike-handling procedures was found on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with an active website, confirmed address, and multiple amenities of interest to touring cyclists including complimentary bicycle rentals and laundry.
enrichment_extras.notes: The hotel offers complimentary cruiser bicycle rentals (explicitly listed on the amenities page), which is notable for a touring-cyclist directory even though no secure storage for guests' own bikes is mentioned. The OSM address omits the postal code; the website confirms V8L 1X2.

Laundry.detail: Self-serve guest laundry facilities available; coin-operated machines with detergent available at the front desk

wow_evidence: complimentary cruiser bicycle rentals so guests can explore the Saanich Peninsula... laundry
